scope: Authored geometry/navigation/clearance/staged sightlines; not mission, actual cover/climb controls, boss AI, pacing playtest, verifier/version, streaming/device/performance acceptance

navigation.scope: canonical conservative enemy lattice, not a playable map, player-traversal/arena/sightline/spawn/performance or verifier acceptance
navigation.distanceBasis: Shortest directed lattice steps between cell centres, not actor paths or exact point-to-point distances

metrics.fractionBasis: cell centres inside exact bounds; lattice estimate, not geometric area fraction
